scope: Theorem 2.3 (Multiplicative large sieve) of the manuscript “Weighted dilation graphs, smooth shifted primes and totient fibers” (preprints/Weighted-Dilation-Graphs-Smooth-Shifted-Primes-and-Totient-Fibers-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 011 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 351692885d112277), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let I be a real interval of length H, let an be complex numbers supported on I ∩ Z, and let R ≥ 1. Then X r≤R r φ(r) ∗ X χ mod r X n∈I∩Z anχ(n) 2 ≪ (H + 1 + R2 ) X n |an|2 , where the asterisk restricts the sum to primitive Dirichlet characters.
